### Herod’s Discernment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/herods-discernment
Passage: Mark 6:20
Points:
- Even depraved sinners retain the capacity to recognize holiness and divine truth.
- Herod Antipas recognized John as a holy prophet and protected him from execution for a season.
- Being intrigued by the truth does not save a person without a genuine love for it.
- Unregenerate hearts will ultimately compromise the truth when self-interest and pressure arise.
- Faithful proclamation of God's Word must continue because truth penetrates the human conscience.
